snippet.title: Tavern Rivals – Commanders & Champions Update | PvP Auto Battler
snippet.description:
Play the free demo and Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5186450

Tavern Rivals is a synergy-heavy PvP auto battler where every synergy has a body holding it up. No team health bar, on either side — so protect the minions your engine runs on, and go through the ones holding theirs together.

Build your team with endless combinations of Minions, Commanders and Trinkets, each one offering a different utility for you to find a place for. Battle other players on your road to becoming the Champion.

NEW IN THIS UPDATE
* Commanders: pick one of three at the start of every run. There are 10, each with its own ability that shapes how you build.
* Champion mode: reach 10 wins to contend for the throne. Beat the reigning Champion in round 20 and your board takes the throne, defending it against every challenger.

KEY FEATURES
* Asynchronous PvP Auto Battler
* 70 Minions, 25 Trinkets, 10 Commanders
* Fast runs that take between 15min - 45min
* Deeply synergistic combos, open to be interrupted in unique ways
* Champion mode, compete to become the Champion

Discord: https://discord.gg/MeWKyyj8mv
Website: https://tavernrivals.com
Press kit: https://tavernrivals.com/press

#TavernRivals #AutoBattler #IndieGame
